newsitem.title: USA: Crown Crafts to post charge from recall.
newsitem.headline: Crown Crafts to post charge from recall.

text.p: Crown Crafts Inc and its Hans Benjamin Furniture Inc unit said Thursday it is recalling from retailers of all furniture products manufactured by Hans Benjamin, which will lead to a pretax charge of $1.9 million to $2.5 million.
In addition, the companies have suspended shipments pending an internal investigation of certain labeling issues, Crown Crafts said.
Crown Crafts said the third quarter charge is about $0.21 to $0.26 a share after taxes to cover the costs of the recall and related costs.

These voluntary decisions followed a withholde-from-sale order issued by the California Bureau of Home Furnishings and Thermal insulation, which found that a line of juvenile foam furniture made by Hans Benjamine did not comply with the state's flammability standards, Crown Crafts said.
The order, which was received October 28, 1996, also states that the labels on the products incorrectly represent that the California standard is met, Crown Crafts said.
Crown Crafts said its internal investigation revealed that some Hans Benjamin juvenile furniture and some other products shipped to locations other than California may have been similarly mislabeled.
The voluntary recall applies to all Hans Benjamin furniture products in the hands of retailers in 49 states.

The products include both juvenile foam furniture and wood frame benches, stools, ottomans and similar products. It does not apply to products in California that continue to be held off sale pursuant to the bureau's order.
